newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 96/97 budget surplus seen at HK$15.1 bln -Tsang.
newsitem.headline: HK 96/97 budget surplus seen at HK$15.1 bln -Tsang.

text.p: Hong Kong was estimated to record a budget surplus of HK$15.1 billion for the fiscal year ending March 31 compared with a forecast HK$1.6 billion, Financial Secretary Donald Tsang said on Wednesday.

"I am now forecasting a surplus for 1996/97 of HK$15.1 billion. This is a substantial increase over the HK$1.6 million I originally estimated in my 1996 budget," Tsang said in his 1997/98 budget speech to the Legislative Council.
He said revenue for the year was HK$6.6 billion more than originally estimated, while underspending amounted to HK$6.9 billion.
